summary: Standalone ferby-settings-core crate with serde schema matching frozen AppSettings contract, versioned JSON envelope, strict bounds/byte caps, symlink/non-regular target rejection, atomic sibling replacement, and 7 tempdir tests; refreshed current file snapshots. Proposed C04 integration: link ferby-settings-core in src-tauri/Cargo.toml and pass Tauri app_config_dir() to load_settings/save_settings commands.
risks: Single-directory POSIX rename atomicity with last-writer-wins concurrency; Tauri command registration and app_config_dir resolution belong to Codex C04 integration.
